questions.question: What does God remind the people of in Jeremiah 11?
options: The great temple that he commanded Solomon the king to build for him there
The covenant he made with their fathers when he brought them out of Egypt
The everlasting promise of land that he first made to Abraham of old
The royal throne that he established forever for the house of David
questions.answer: The covenant he made with their fathers when he brought them out of Egypt

questions.question: What did the men of Anathoth plot in Jeremiah 11?
options: To drive the prophet out of the land
To make Jeremiah their king instead
To kill Jeremiah and stop his prophesying
questions.answer: To kill Jeremiah and stop his prophesying
